reviews.title: Terrible return policy
reviews.text: Only have 30 days to do exchanges or returns.  Situations change and 30 days is not enough.  I would even be happy with in store credit but company is unwilling to work with me

reviews.title: Did not get my money back
reviews.text: When I started a return it asked me how I would like my money back (card or gift card) . I chose the full amount to my card option.  However, I received all of it on a gift card and they said they can’t change it now. The only reason I had to return it so many times is because the sizing is inconsistent.

reviews.title: Not functional
reviews.text: App is not displaying any images and regularly doesn’t work

reviews.title: Great website, sucky app
reviews.text: This app experience is horrible. It doesn’t save my favorites, and to order for try on you have to scroll through every single dress option, there is no search feature.

reviews.title: Never Shipped
reviews.text: I have prom may 2nd and the app said that the dress would ship in 2.5 weeks and get here from 1-7 days.. so basically I was under the impression that the dress would arrive on time especially since the estimated delivery date was april 25th-april 29th. It has been almost 4 weeks and my dress still hasn’t shipped, I have reached out to customer service 3 times with no response. I now have to get a last minute dress due to this issue. I would expect more from a brand that makes wedding dresses. This is ridiculous.

reviews.title: Do not buy!
reviews.text: Do not buy from or support this company they are dishonest and sneaky. They will charge you $7 per return when you are the one going to a return center. Their sizing is not accurate and they punish you for returns by charging you an absurd amount absolutely. Would never support them again, avoid at all costs.

reviews.title: Suits
reviews.text: Probably the worst customer service alive nobody can tell you if your suit will be there on time or where it’s even at.

reviews.title: Awful tech but good selection
reviews.text: The app has so many bugs I tried to switch to another brand multiple times. Ended up having to do this one anyway because of the options available. It empties your cart if you take too long to enter your credit card number. It says items are quick ship when they are NOT and then you find out after order confirmation. It’s a huge pain to return try on dresses.

reviews.title: ALL try on dresses out of stock?
reviews.text: I think the dresses on this site are beautiful. I don’t understand how almost every single try on option is out of stock. Every size. Every color. I managed to find 2 to try on but I have looked at so many dresses that every size & color are out of stock.

reviews.title: App is terrible
reviews.text: The website is perfectly fine but whenever I try to use the app under the bridal section NOTHING ever loads. I’ve tried months apart after multiple updates saying bug fixes and still it doesn’t work. Have to keep using the website. Also there’s a dress that has a video pop up that will not go away and cause you to not be able to exit or do anything at all.

reviews.title: App doesn’t work
reviews.text: Doesn’t let me login. All my info is correct and I hit the login button and nothing happens.

reviews.title: Custom Size Bridesmaid Dress
reviews.text: I ordered a custom sized dress and it did not fit at all! The top was two sizes too big and my chest was falling out the center was just as large! No returns available seems unfair when the custom sizes are clearly incorrect!

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: When I click on the app it keeps opening indeed.
